blocks.prompt:
1 Bone is a living tissue. (i) Describe the three types of bone cells. (ii) Describe red and yellow bone marrow. (4 marks)
(Haddi zinda tissue hai. (i) Haddi ke teen qisam ke cells bayan karein. (ii) Red aur yellow bone marrow bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Bone cells: haddi ki banawat, growth aur remodelling mein teen qisam ke cells kaam karte hain.
• Osteoblasts: haddi banane wale cells jo unmineralized ground substance banate aur kharij karte hain. Matrix mein ghir jane par yeh osteocytes ban jate hain.
• Osteocytes: mature bone cells jo lacunae mein hote hain. Yeh enzymes aur bone mineral kharij kar ke bone tissue ko sehatmand rakhte hain aur haddi se khoon mein calcium ke ikhraj ko control karte hain.
• Osteoclasts: macrophages se bante hain aur bone resorption karte hain, yani haddi tor kar khoon mein calcium aur phosphate chhorte hain. In ka kaam haddi ki growth aur marammat ke liye zaroori hai.

(ii) Bone marrow: bohat si haddiyon mein naram tissue bone marrow hota hai, red ya yellow.
• Red bone marrow spongy bone, lambi haddiyon ke siron, pasliyon, vertebrae, sternum aur pelvis mein hota hai. Yeh red blood cells, platelets aur white blood cells banata hai.
• Yellow bone marrow lambi haddiyon ke shaft mein hota hai. Yeh zyada tar fat cells ka bana hai aur energy ka zakheera hai. Shadeed khoon behne par yeh red marrow ban kar khoon ke cells bana sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: There are three types of cells i.e., osteoblasts, osteocytes, and osteoclasts

blocks.prompt:
2 Define osteogenesis. Describe how a long bone develops from cartilage, and how a few bones form without cartilage. (4 marks)
(Osteogenesis ki definition likhein. Bayan karein ke lambi haddi cartilage se kaise banti hai aur kuch haddiyan cartilage ke baghair kaise banti hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Osteogenesis: haddi banne ka amal. Yeh embryo mein shuru ho kar saari zindagi jari rehta hai aur haddiyon ki growth, dekh bhaal aur marammat mein ahem hai. Is ke do raaste hain.

1. Lambi haddiyon (maslan femur, humerus) ka cartilage se banna:
• Cartilage ka darmiyan sakht (calcify) hone lagta hai aur wahan ke chondrocytes mar kar khali jaghein (cavities) chhorte hain.
• Blood vessels in jaghon mein dakhil ho kar osteoblasts aur osteoclasts late hain.
• Osteoblasts haddi ka tissue bana kar cartilage ki jagah lete hain. Minerals jama ho kar cartilage ki jagah haddi banne ka qadam ossification kehlata hai.
• Osteoclasts calcified cartilage tor kar mazeed haddi ke liye jagah banate hain.
• Haddi pakne par kuch osteoblasts tissue mein qaid ho kar osteocytes ban jate hain jo haddi ki banawat qaim rakhte hain.
• Yeh amal tab tak chalta hai jab tak saari cartilage haddi na ban jaye, siwaye jor (articular) ki satahon ke.

2. Seedha banna: kuch haddiyan, maslan khopri ki kuch haddiyan, pehle cartilage banaye baghair seedhi sakht haddi banti hain. Cells pehle embryonic connective tissue mein bikhre hote hain magar jald tehon mein jur kar haddi ki chapti plates ban jate hain.

Haddiyan poori banne ke baad bhi osteogenesis bone remodelling ki shakal mein jari rehta hai: osteoclasts purani haddi torte aur osteoblasts nayi haddi banate hain.

book_ref.quote: The formation of long bones e.g., femur and humerus, involves the transition of cartilage into bone.

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe the structure of cartilage tissue. (i) Describe its perichondrium, matrix and cells. (ii) Compare bone and cartilage. (4 marks)
(Cartilage tissue ki banawat bayan karein. (i) Is ki perichondrium, matrix aur cells bayan karein. (ii) Bone aur cartilage ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Cartilage ki banawat:
• Perichondrium: cartilage ko gherne wali connective tissue ki teh. Is mein blood vessels, lymphatic vessels aur nerves hain jo cartilage ko supply deti hain.
• Cartilage matrix: perichondrium ke andar; collagen, elastin, proteoglycans aur doosre fibres ka bana. Yeh tissue ko taqat, lachak aur dabao ke khilaf mazahmat deta hai. Doosre connective tissues ke baraks matrix ke andar blood vessels nahi; cells ko diffusion se khurak milti hai, is liye cartilage bohat aahista theek hoti hai.
• Chondrocytes: cartilage ke cells jo matrix mein dhansi chhoti jaghon (lacunae) mein hote hain. Yeh matrix banate aur qaim rakhte hain.
Kuch cartilage saari zindagi lachak ke liye rehti hai, maslan haddiyon ke darmiyan, naak ke sire, bahari kaan aur trachea ke andar.

(ii) Bone aur cartilage ka muqabla table mein hai.

book_ref.quote: Inside perichondrium is the cartilage matrix

blocks.prompt:
4 What is the axial skeleton? Describe the bones of the skull, middle ear and neck. (4 marks)
(Axial skeleton kya hai? Khopri, darmiyani kaan aur gardan ki haddiyan bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Axial skeleton: jism ka mehwar (axis) banata hai; is ki haddiyan sar, gardan aur seene ke aaza ko sahara aur hifazat deti hain. Is mein khopri, pasliyan, reerh ki haddi aur sternum hain.

Khopri (22 haddiyan):
• Cranium (dimagh ka dabba): aath cranial haddiyan. Jora: parietal aur temporal (2 jore). Be-jora: frontal, occipital, ethmoid aur sphenoid.
• Chehra: cranium se juri chaudah facial haddiyan. Jora (6 jore): lacrimal, zygomatic, nasal, inferior nasal concha, maxilla aur palatine. Be-jora: mandible (jabre ki haddi) aur vomer.

Darmiyani kaan: 6 haddiyan (3 jore) jinhein ossicles kehte hain: malleus, incus aur stapes.

Gardan ki haddi: hyoid, khopri ki bunyad par zabaan ke neeche chhoti akeli haddi. Yeh sar ki kisi aur haddi se jor nahi banati.

book_ref.quote: The axial skeleton forms the axis of the body.

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe the vertebral column and the rib cage of man. (4 marks)
(Insan ke vertebral column aur rib cage bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Vertebral column: 33 haddiyan jinhein vertebrae kehte hain, paanch groups mein:
• Saat cervical vertebrae: gardan ke; pehla atlas aur doosra axis.
• Barah thoracic vertebrae: seene ke pasliyan uthane wale vertebrae.
• Paanch lumbar vertebrae: pait ke hisse mein.
• Paanch sacral vertebrae: jur kar sacrum banate hain jo koolhe ki iliac haddiyon se jur kar pelvis ki pichhli taraf banata hai.
• Chaar coccygeal vertebrae (coccyx): baligh mein jure hue. Sacral aur coccygeal mil kar pelvic vertebrae kehlate hain.

Rib cage: 24 haddiyan (12 jore) jinhein pasliyan (ribs) kehte hain, aur aik sternum.
• Sternum (seene ki haddi): seene ke darmiyan lambi chapti haddi.
• Pasliyan peeche ki taraf thoracic vertebrae se jurti hain.
• True ribs: pehle 7 jore, alag alag costal cartilages se seedhe sternum se jure.
• False ribs: 8wan, 9wan aur 10wan jora, mushtarka costal cartilage se sternum se jure.
• Floating ribs: aakhri 2 jore (11wan aur 12wan), jo sternum se nahi jurte.

book_ref.quote: It consists of 33 bones called vertebrae.

blocks.prompt:
6 What is the appendicular skeleton? Describe the pectoral girdle and the pelvic girdle. (4 marks)
(Appendicular skeleton kya hai? Pectoral girdle aur pelvic girdle bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Appendicular skeleton: bazuon aur taangon (appendages) ki haddiyan: pectoral girdle, pelvic girdle, forelimbs aur hindlimbs.

Pectoral girdle: haddiyon ke 2 jore, aik jora clavicles (hasli ki haddiyan) aur aik jora scapulae (kandhe ki haddiyan). Har clavicle ka aik sira sternum aur doosra scapula se jurta hai. Humerus ka gol sar glenoid cavity mein fit hota hai.

Pelvic girdle: do hip bones ka bana. Har hip bone mein 3 haddiyan: ilium, ischium aur pubis. Har hip bone mein in teeno ke jurne se bana haddi ka socket acetabulum hai jis mein femur ka sar fit hota hai. Dono hip bones aage se pubic symphysis se jure hain, jo darmiyani lakeer par pubic haddiyon ko jorne wala cartilaginous joint hai. Peeche sacrum iliac haddiyon se jurta hai.

book_ref.quote: These are pectoral girdle, pelvic girdle, forelimbs and hindlimbs.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book correction: book mein hip bone ki haddi 'ileum' chhapi hai. Sahi naam ilium hai; ileum chhoti aant ka aakhri hissa hai.

blocks.prompt:
7 Compare the bones of a forelimb with those of a hindlimb. (4 marks)
(Forelimb aur hindlimb ki haddiyon ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Har forelimb (bazu, kalai, haath, ungliyan) aur har hindlimb (taang, takhna, paon, ungliyan) mein 30 haddiyan hain. In ka muqabla table mein hai.

Notes: humerus ka sar glenoid cavity mein aur femur ka sar acetabulum mein fit hota hai. Ulna andar ki taraf aur radius se thori bari hai; radius angoothe ki taraf hai, aur carpals ki upar wali qatar radius se jur kar kalai ka jor banati hai. Patella ghutne ke upar se guzarne wale lambe tendon mein dhansi hai. Fibula ghutne ke zara neeche aur takhne ke zara upar tibia se jurti hai.

book_ref.quote: Each hindlimb (leg, ankle, foot, toes) consists of 30 bones.

blocks.prompt:
8 Define a joint. Describe fibrous joints and cartilaginous joints with examples. (4 marks)
(Joint ki definition likhein. Fibrous aur cartilaginous joints misalon ke saath bayan karein.)

book_ref.quote: In these joints, the bones are connected by a layer of cartilage.

blocks.prompt:
9 Describe the structure of a synovial joint and its six main types with examples. (4 marks)
(Synovial joint ki banawat aur is ki chhe bari qismein misalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Synovial joints jism ke sab se aam jor hain aur bohat zyada harkat dete hain.

Banawat:
• Articular cartilage: chikni, sakht, lachakdar hyaline cartilage jo haddiyon ke siron ko dhanpti hai; harkat ke liye bina ragar ki satah deti hai.
• Fibrous capsule: jor ko gher kar haddiyon ko jore rakhta hai. Is ki bahari teh ligaments aur andaruni teh synovial membrane hai.
• Synovial membrane synovial fluid kharij karti hai jo jor ko chikna rakhta hai.
• Ligaments: connective tissue ki mazboot pattiyan jo jor ki haddiyon ko jorti hain.

Qismein (harkat ki had ke lihaz se):
1. Ball-and-socket: har simt mein harkat, maslan kandha aur koolha.
2. Hinge: darwaze ke qabze ki tarah sirf aik plane mein, maslan kohni aur ghutna.
3. Pivot: aik axis ke gird ghumao, maslan gardan ke pehle aur doosre vertebra ka jor.
4. Ellipsoidal: do planes mein harkat magar ghumao nahi, maslan kalai aur radius.
5. Saddle: do planes mein harkat kyun ke aik haddi concave aur doosri convex hai, maslan angootha.
6. Gliding: phisalne wali harkat, maslan vertebrae ke darmiyan aur kalai aur takhne ki haddiyon ke darmiyan.

book_ref.quote: Synovial joints are the most common type of joint in the human body

blocks.prompt:
10 What is joint transplantation? Describe its four common types. (4 marks)
(Joint transplantation kya hai? Is ki chaar aam qismein bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Joint transplantation aik surgical amal hai jis mein kharab jor ko donor ke sehatmand qudrati jor ya masnooi jor se badla jata hai. Aam qismein:

1. Total joint replacement: poora kharab jor metal, plastic ya ceramic ke masnooi jor se badla jata hai.
2. Partial joint replacement: jor ka sirf kharab hissa masnooi hisse se badla jata hai; aksar ghutne mein.
3. Allograft transplantation: donor ka sehatmand jor laga kar kharab jor badla jata hai; aksar takhne aur ghutne mein.
4. Chondrocyte implantation: mareez ke apne jor ke chondrocytes kharab jor mein lagaye jate hain; aksar ghutne mein.

blocks.prompt:
11 Explain how the human skeleton and musculature help in the bipedal posture. Name the problems caused by improper posture. (4 marks)
(Bayan karein ke insani skeleton aur muscles do paon par khare hone (bipedal posture) mein kaise madad dete hain. Ghalat posture se hone wale masail ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Bipedal posture mein madad dene wali khoobiyan:
1. Reerh ki haddi ka khaas S shakal ka kham wazan barabar baant'ta aur khare hone aur chalne mein tawazun rakhta hai.
2. Pelvis chhota aur chaura hai; yeh dhar ko mustahkam rakhta aur wazan do taangon par sambhalta hai.
3. Femur ghutne ki taraf andar ko jhuka hai, jis se jism ka centre of mass paon ke upar rehta hai.
4. Koolhe ke muscles bohat bare hain; yeh dhar ko mustahkam rakhte aur chalte waqt jism ko aage dhakelte hain.
5. Pindli ke muscles khoob bane hain jo chalne aur daurne ki taqat dete hain.
6. Paon ki longitudinal arch (lambai wali mehraab) jhatka jazb karti aur wazan barabar baant'ti hai.
7. Ungliyan chhoti aur kam pakarne wali hain, is liye paon chalne aur daurne mein achha lever banta hai.

Ghalat posture ke masail: vertebral misalignment (kamar aur gardan dard, herniated discs), joint strain (gardan, kandhon, koolhon aur ghutnon mein dard aur soojan, shayad arthritis) aur muscle imbalance (haddiyan aur jor seedh se hat jate hain).

book_ref.quote: The bipedal posture of humans is linked to skeleton and musculature in several ways.

blocks.prompt:
13 Sprain is a common injury to joints. (i) What is a sprain? (ii) Describe the first aid treatment for a dislocation and a sprain. (4 marks)
(Sprain joron ki aam chot hai. (i) Sprain kya hai? (ii) Dislocation aur sprain ki first aid bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Sprain (moch): jor ki haddiyan jorne wale ligaments ki chot. Yeh tab hoti hai jab jor ko us ki aam had se zyada mora jaye aur ligaments khinch ya phat jayein. Aam tor par takhne, ghutne aur kalai ke ligaments zakhmi hote hain. Ilaj aam tor par physical therapy se hota hai aur patti (dressing) se moch wala hissa be-harkat aur sahara diya jata hai.

(ii) Dislocation aur sprain ki first aid:
1. Hissa be-harkat karein: use hilne na dein aur utre jor ko khud seedha karne ki koshish na karein; sling ya splint se sahara dein.
2. Barf lagayein: ice pack ya thandi patti soojan aur dard kam karti hai.
3. Hissa upar uthayein: dislocation mein mumkin ho to hissa upar rakhein taa ke soojan kam ho.
4. Doctor ki madad lein: 1122 par emergency medical services ko call karein ya hospital le jayein. Utra jor doctor hi wapas bithata hai.

book_ref.quote: This can happen when the joint is forced beyond its normal range of motion

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book correction: book mein likha hai ke utra hua jor sirf physiotherapist theek kar sakta hai. Sahi yeh hai ke doctor (aksar X-ray ke baad, dard ki dawa ya anaesthesia ke saath) jor wapas bithata hai; physiotherapy baad mein sehat yabi ke liye hai.

blocks.prompt:
14 Describe the biochemistry of thick and thin myofilaments of skeletal muscle. (4 marks)
(Skeletal muscle ki moti (thick) aur patli (thin) myofilaments ki biochemistry bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Myofibrils do qisam ki myofilaments se bane hain: moti (myosin) aur patli (actin).

Moti myofilaments:
• taqreeban 16 nm diameter, bohat se myosin proteins se bani;
• har myosin protein do lipti hui polypeptide chains ka hai jo gol 'head' par khatam hoti hain;
• myosin heads moti filament se bahar nikle hote hain aur contraction mein actin se jurte hain.

Patli myofilaments: 7-8 nm diameter, teen proteins se bani:
1. Actin: core actin ki do mudi hui ladiyon ka hai.
2. Tropomyosin: do ladiyan actin core ke gird lipat kar use sakht karti hain; dheele fibre mein actin par myosin binding sites band rakhti hain.
3. Troponin: patli filament par mukarrar faslon par, teen polypeptides ka: aik inhibitory jo actin se jurti hai; doosri tropomyosin se jur kar use jagah par rakhti hai; teesri calcium ions se jurti hai.

book_ref.quote: Thick myofilaments, about 16 nm in diameter, are made up of many myosin proteins.

blocks.prompt:
15 Describe the bands and lines of a sarcomere. Explain what happens to each of them during muscle contraction. (4 marks)
(Sarcomere ki bands aur lines bayan karein. Contraction ke dauran in mein se har aik ke saath kya hota hai, samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Sarcomere ki bands aur lines:
• Z-lines: protein discs jin se patli actin filaments juri hoti hain; do Z-lines ka darmiyani hissa sarcomere hai, contraction ki sab se chhoti unit.
• A-band: moti (myosin) filaments se bani gehri band, jahan patli filaments un par chadhi hoti hain.
• I-band: patli (actin) filaments se bani halki band.
• H-band (H-zone): A-band ka halka darmiyani hissa jahan overlap nahi hota.
• M line: H-band ke darmiyan mojood ho sakne wali gehri lakeer; moti filaments ko mustahkam rakhti hai.

Contraction ke dauran tabdeeliyan:
• Patli filaments A-band mein mazeed andar phisalti hain, is liye H-band aur I-band tang ho jati hain; H-zone ghayab ho jata hai.
• Z-lines qareeb aati hain, yun sarcomere chhota hota hai.
• A-bands khud chhoti nahi hoti; saath wali A-bands aik doosre ke qareeb aa jati hain.
• Yeh tamam sarcomeres mein aik saath hota hai, is liye poora muscle chhota hota hai.

book_ref.quote: During muscle contraction, the thin filaments slide deeper into the A-band

blocks.prompt:
16 Explain the roles of calcium ions and ATP in the contraction of a skeletal muscle. (4 marks)
(Skeletal muscle ke sukarne mein calcium ions aur ATP ka kirdar samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Calcium ions ka kirdar:
• Dheele muscle mein actin ki binding sites tropomyosin se band hoti hain, is liye myosin heads nahi jur sakte.
• Nerve impulse se motor neuron acetylcholine chhorta hai; sarcolemma apna impulse banata hai jo T-tubules aur phir sarcoplasmic reticulum (SR) tak jata hai.
• SR cytosol mein calcium ions chhorta hai. Calcium troponin se jurta hai, jo tropomyosin ko actin ki myosin binding sites se hata deta hai.
• Khuli sites par myosin heads jur kar cross-bridges banate hain aur contraction shuru hota hai.

ATP ka kirdar:
• Dheeli halat mein myosin heads pehle hi ATP ko ADP aur Pi mein tor chuke hote hain.
• Cross-bridges banne ke baad heads ADP aur Pi chhorte, shakal badalte aur sarcomere ke darmiyan ki taraf jhuk kar actin khainchte hain: power stroke.
• Naya ATP molecule myosin head se jur kar use actin se alag karta hai. Is ATP ke ADP aur Pi mein tootne se head asal shakal mein wapas aata hai aur cycle dohraya jata hai.
• Maut ke baad ATP nahi banta, is liye cross-bridges nahi tootte: rigor mortis. Warzish mein ATP khatam hone par muscle sukar nahi sakta (fatigue).

book_ref.quote: These calcium ions bind to troponin, causing it to shift tropomyosin

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: calcium 'darwaza kholta' hai (tropomyosin hata kar binding sites kholta hai), aur ATP 'chhurata' hai (myosin head ko actin se alag karta hai aur agle stroke ke liye tayyar karta hai).

blocks.prompt:
17 How are skeletal muscles attached to bones? Explain the antagonistic arrangement of muscles with reference to flexors and extensors. (4 marks)
(Skeletal muscles haddiyon se kaise jure hote hain? Flexors aur extensors ke hawale se muscles ki antagonistic tarteeb samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Jurao: skeletal muscles sakht connective tissues, tendons, se haddiyon se jure hote hain; tendons muscle ke siron par is ke collagen aur connective tissue se bante hain. Muscle ke aam tor par do mukhtalif haddiyon par do jurne ke muqam hote hain:
• Origin: woh sira jo contraction mein na hilne wali haddi se jura ho.
• Insertion: woh sira jo hilne wali haddi se jura ho.
• Belly: muscle ka darmiyani hissa.

Antagonistic tarteeb: muscles sirf khainch sakte hain, is liye jor par haddi ko do simton mein hilane ke liye yeh joron mein kaam karte hain jo mukhalif amal karte hain.
• Flexor sukarta hai to jor par haddi murti hai, aur extensor dheela hota hai.
• Mukhalif extensor sukarta hai to haddi seedhi hoti hai, aur flexor dheela hota hai.
• Mukhalif muscle ka khinchao dheele muscle ko dobara lamba karta hai.
Misaal (ghutna): hamstrings (raan ke peeche) nichli taang ko morte aur quadriceps (raan ke aage) seedha karte hain; aik sukarta hai to doosra dheela hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Skeletal muscles are attached to bones by tough connective tissues called tendons.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book correction: aik box mein likha hai ke muscle aam tor par sirf aik sire par haddi se jura hota hai. Sahi yeh hai ke muscle dono siron par tendons se jura hota hai (origin aur insertion); woh dhakel is liye nahi sakta ke us ke fibres sirf sukar sakte hain.
